title: Worked Examples and Fading
description: AIL 606 textbook section connecting worked examples and fading to storyboard frame sequence with narration, signaling, and reader-action notes, reader notes, support moments, and revision evidence.
learning_objectives: Explain the [worked-example effect](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Worked-example_effect) in terms of search load versus schema-building load.
Engineer a fading sequence (worked, completion, open) matched to the learner's growing schema.
Document a bounded AI/software support move with accepted and rejected suggestions.
Use annotations, support requests, and revision notes to decide what help or design change should come next.
